eligibility_rules: Small/medium/large-scale farmers are eligible to apply for this scheme. The farmer should be a resident of Chhattisgarh State.
documents_required: It is mandatory for the beneficiary to have agricultural land and water source (borewell,
well, river/stream etc.) in his own name. Application form. Attested photocopy of address proof. Attested photocopy of Aadhaar
card. Khasra/area of land and attested map of the workplace. Attested photocopy of caste certificate. Amount of processing fee. Two
how_to_apply: Mode: Online & Offline The first applicants have to open the official Website. Click on "Saur Sujala Yojana Online Apply" . In the next window select the scheme name. Fill out the required details. Provide the bank details and Submit.
